chapter: Routine bands and the lake dances
title: Jack Carey's band and other routine bands
summary: Williams names Carey's band members and lists reading and routine bands such as Sam Morgan, Celestine, Robichaux, Piron and Olympia.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was in Jack's band then?
Jack was on trombone. Had a mud carrier on trumpet. Had this boy Willie on clarinet. Sometimes he had Zip on clarinet. You heard him, Zip? Yeah, sure.
Willie, I don't know which Willie that is.
Willie, what's his Willie name? Willie Joseph. Oh, Kaiser. Yeah, that's his name, Willie. I don't know him. He came right back from California, come right and got killed.
Well, his brother told me about that.
Was Jack Kerri's band very good?
Oh, yeah. There's a routine band that's good.
Who were some of the other outstanding routine bands?

Well, I had Jack Kerri, René, Sam Morgan. Punchy was playing with Celestine. Celestine always did read his band. Robichauds and Piron, he always read. The Olympic band, they was good. They read and play routine too. Who was on the Olympia?
Well, I know them, but I hadn't forgotten their name.
